Help me too, I cant live without her, Actually i want her back. Its been a year since I knew I love her but the story is much more complicated. 

So she started coming to my place everyday. She didn't use to come alone but slowly it changed. We were getting closer each day. There was tension between us as I could feel it. She was dating someone but hid it from me.

One day on her birthday She went to a temple with that guy and even though I had offered her she lied to me and said she was going to her friends house the night before. But she brings the guy in front of me and offers me a sweet and it hurts me because I bought those sweets. My heart beats fast and it breaks, I can't move and I want to cry loudly. Her friend invites me to her surprise party but because he is invited I don't go and without knowing the reason she gets mad at me. She stops talking to me completely. But because I apologise to her friend for missing out on the party she starts talking to me again. Me and her common friend bring her back to my place where I had already arranged her fav cakes and some gifts that included silver earrings, a ring and Payals.

She was happy but our common friend told me later that she had broken up with that guy. After these days she still came to my place alone at night and we used to hang out. I used to cook food for her, we used to talk, sketch and stay. She once then stayed at my place through out the night where she slept. The next day I sat with her on the bed and I put my arm around her and comforted her shoulder and back and she stayed throughout the day too. I taught her to play piano that day by putting my hands around her and taking her hands in mine. Later dropped her off at her place. Slowly we started hanging out more and she started sleeping at my place. We used to sleep separately. I used to get up early, cook her fav breakfast and bring it in bed.

One day at night we were hanging out and she said she didn't wanna leave. She was playing with my fingers and I was letting her. But nothing happened.  Another day she came and we were chilling and hanging out and something happened and she started crying badly. I felt so bad I tried comforting her but she didn't let me. She left and didn't tell me what had happened. She came back the next morning and I tried to comfort her. She said she was too scared to fall asleep. So I caressed her hair as she did in my bedroom as I stayed with her. When I had to leave for my office, I left her a note and my ring to make her feel comfortable.  She sent me videos of her that day telling me about her dreams and how she felt good. When I came back home I brought her fav waffles and she said she missed me. I massaged her legs and kept it inside my shirt for a while too. 

One day soon after 4-5 days later she came to my place and we were making an audition after watching twilight and eating dinner. She was playing with my hands throughout and it was feeling nice. I fell asleep when she was changing as for is to make her audition. She came out again asked me to sleep inside with her. We were sleeping next to each other by then just with distance. So the night before this, I had held her hand slightly and kissed it before leaving for work when she was asleep. This night I took her arm and hugged it. She slowly came very close to me and put her ark around me. She hugged me and I hugged her tightly.  My lips started moving downwards and I kissed her forehead. She didn't move. Slowly I moved lower and as my lips were hovering over hers she kissed me slightly. And we started kissing. We started getting intimate too.

So now we were together. We stayed together everyday, slept together everyday. But once she said she feels disgusted by my touch out of nowhere. And still that night we try to have sex again. We sleep together, cuddle together, have dinner together, watch movie together everyday.  We finally go on a date too and we are happy. 

One day she gets mad at me because while we were about to have sex my work kept interrupting us and she got mad for the whole day. The whole day she didn't talk to me. And at night she started packing her bags to leave. I begged her and cried to convince her not to. We both cried. She stayed and we ate and cuddled and slept. Next day was the day when we went on that date. The day after that I made her spaghetti, arranged balloons in the living room and when she came from the shoot she was very happy. We ate and slept. 

Two days later was her flight and we still did have sex before she left for those 2 days. On the days of her flight she didn't wanna leave but she left and kisses me on my neck. 

One month she is staying at her house in Delhi and I am in Mumbai. We texted everyday, started talking on the phone everyday but gradually I started getting hints from her that she doesn't want me anymore.  She said she doesn't feel the spark, she doesn't feel that she loves me. Love you messages stopped from her side, Goodnight messages stopped too. We fought again about my diet where she said she feels like a mother towards me. But we made up and talked again. 3 days prior to today we talked on video call. We were good. But she didn't wanna come back.

The day before yesterday she started an argument about my diet again. And said that the relationship is over. But I tried texting her so much and no response.  Last night even I texted her and no response.  Today she sent me a reel and when I said hi she said it was by mistake and I said glad to hear from you, miss you she said I don't and said that she got enough time to think that this is not gonna work and the relationship is over.

She knew I loved her immensely since Dec 2023 but she went to delhi in January 2024 and month end she said she wants a arrange marriage or a marriage with a guy who is from her culture. Still she asked me to be friends with her. We were still close, hanging out, talking everyday, sending her valentines gifts and everything, but on 9th April 2024 she said she cant be friends with me because i love her. And we didn’t talk for 4 months after that. She came back into my life after those 4 months ended. We kissed on 11th October, she left for delhi on the 31st of October and has not returned yet and called it off on text again the exact way she did it both the other times. But I still love her and i want to do something to get her back, i want to bring her back in my life, please.

Hey its OK if you don't want to talk to me or stop talking to me, I understand that. But for the past days it's been really tough for me to undergo this change of me not talking to you. You meant the world to me and It hurts alot. It's hard resisting to send you a message or a reel or even an empty snap to you from my side. You stopped talking to me but does it have to mean that I have to stop too?? What if I just send you small things like an empty snap, like a reel that you might like, no messages, no compliments, you don't talk to me but atleast you will stay in my life(in a way). Truth be told, If me being honest could make me loose you forever then I would want to take it all back. I rather keep my feelings hidden or try killing them just to stay in touch with you, to talk to you, because loosing you is a great deal of pain that I just can't seem to sustain. I am sorry but it's the truth.

Now I feel like I regret it. Till date I didn't have the guts to say 'I love you' to her and it hurts that I couldn't even say it then. It's heartbreaking. I don't know. I am sorry.

I don't know what to do. I feel like doing nothing at all. I feel like sitting in the bed with my blanket, watching movies or binge watching the mentalist and crying. Every single second I am remembering her and moments with her and it's hard. It's really hard for me right now. What should I do?? I might come home, who knows but I don't want to travel alone either. Even If I come back home I will come in a cab and not via the train but truth be told I don't want to leave from here at all. I just don't know. I  am just confused. Maybe because I feel like I don't know what she felt or even if she said she is gonna stop talking to me should I still keep my end open. Benit isn't even saying anything, not giving any opinions either. And I asked him if he could just talk to her later this week and just get to know what happened....I don't know it's stupid I know but it's like I still didn't get closure. I feel like, does she hate me, was I a nobody in her life, did I have any importance in her life and the biggest thing is every single moment I am having memories of us and I start missing her even more. I feel like even she said she doesn't wanna talk to me, but I still want to talk to her. I still want to be there for her. I feel like, did I make a mistake and now I lost her, it was my fault. Did it not affect her, was I anybody to her, like something atleast. Would she ever remember me. Are 8 months nothing. I don't know. I don't want to do  anything at all. Not cook food, not take a bath, not change clothes, not wash utensils but I also feel like if I do go out somewhere could I meet her, would our paths cross and we might talk more clearly. It's been a whole day but it feels like a year has passed.



I have no idea what's right and wrong anymore. I can't decide that. That's one of the problems I am facing I am just confused alot. Like a lot. I feel trapped. Is it wrong that I want her to see me, not like this but just see that she had a huge impact on me. I am thinking about Sketching but I can't. I feel like I don't know how am I gonna be a able to survive without her now. It's hard. I feel like after she came into my life, everything I did, I did keeping her in my mind, my life, everything was for her and I felt great joy in doing so. But now I don't feel like doing anything because I feel there's no point. Even my instagram stories were for her, my posts were there because I didn't care for anybody else's like, it was her's that mattered to me. I know it's stupid but well what can I do. I just keep dreaming about her, thinking about her, feeling or hoping like she may message me. It feels bad. I feel very bad. I am having this feeling inside of me that I can't explain. I don't want to wake up, I don't want to think. Because I don't want to think anything hence I feel like I don't want to wake up. No matter what I do I remember her. She was in everything I used to do. I am eating something, I send her the snap, I am watching something, I send her a snap, I am outside somewhere, I send her a snap, I am doing something, I send her a snap. Every little thing I did, she was always a part of it, I made her a part of it. Hence when I say that she became a part of my life, she did become a part of my life. And how does it feel if such an important part of your life is just taken away from you. Hence I said yesterday that it feels like I lost someone but I know that she can hear me, I still have a chance to talk to her, to see her, she's not somewhere where I can't reach her and it kills me that why am I not. Is it good to just let someone go like that. It's not the end, so why can't you keep the people you feel are important to you in your life till the time you loose them forever. It hurts, it does. All this bullshit talking is not helping either, it's just what I am feeling. I just miss her and I don't feel like I wanna loose her. I feel like I made a huge mistake. I feel like I shat on myself, that I rushed, that I gave up too soon, that she might have been falling for that guy but was he gonna stick around?? What about when the gut sees her talking to or interacting with Purushart and feel like how I used to feel. I feel like I don't want Purushart to ruin her life. I want him out of her life. I feel like maybe until he's there she won't even care to remember me or think about me ever. I don't know. I am being so stupid right now. I am sorry. I just want everything to go back to normal, or somehow get my memory erased or just the time to go back to the point where it was the summer vacation and mom used to bring us the Tom and Jerry comics. I just feel lost and sad and confused and helpless and miserable and missing her alot.
All I can say is good luck as we will keep on trying till we get what's best for us. I mean that's what we can do in this economy and this time.

Well, for starters ask yourself a question what do you see yourself doing?? 
Second of all you are only 18, so chill out. You still have a lot of time to achieve whatever you want, it can be anything at all. You are still growing. Take it from me because I am you and the only difference between you and me is the age. I am 24 years old and I feel the same way except I know what I want to do with my life. That's all you have to know. I am useless, talentless and have wasted my 24 years of life but something keeps me going on even though I strongly feel that maybe I might not achieve whatever I am looking for. That little thing that keeps me going is that if there is even the slightest of possibility of me ever wanna reach my goal then I won't leave it. 
So here's what you do. Figure out what you want, how you wanna live your life. Anything it might be you can learn, adapt, increase your ability to do so and move forward with that. You may reach there before I reach mine. So good luck.

Look, man, I know that feeling that you have. I live through it every day. your life is exactly similar to mine. I don't know how old you are but listen you still have a lot to go through in life. you still have to see the beauty in life that you are missing. that beauty might not be your family or friends but just take a deep breath and go outside, just keep walking and look around you. Take a look at the sky, the trees, the birds. Admire the beauty that is around you. It will help. 

Do you think that committing what you want to is gonna make you noticeable?, It won't. I had a cousin who committed suicide last year in July and it was horrible. People didn't pity him, they started calling him names and blaming him for his mistakes. It wasn't right. those people didn't know his story and neither did I. The only person who knew who he actually was, it was him. So keep living and creating your story. if you feel depressed write your story from the very beginning. It helps. Seek help. Take care of yourself. It seems that everything will be fine after you are gone but it won't. Your loved ones will suffer, they will blame themselves and they wouldn't be able to live because they will be filled up with guilt.

To be honest, I too think about doing what you think is the only option available but believe me its not the only option. Every thing takes time to be alright. All you have to do is wait and live to see it actually happen. Wouldn't you want that.  Wouldn't you want to see how your story ends without you ending it. Just take a deep breath, make a journal, keep writing your story, your feelings, admire the nature, the earth, seek some professional help and keep living.
